info.title: Tuition API
info.description: University tuition REST API (SE 4458 Group 1). All public routes are served through the Kong API gateway. Get a token from POST /api/v1/auth/token, then click Authorize and paste it.

post.summary: Adds or updates the assessed tuition for a student and term.
post.description:
Idempotent upsert keyed by (studentNo, term): a new record returns 201 `CREATED`; the same amount again
returns 200 `UNCHANGED`; a different amount returns 200 `UPDATED`, unless it is below the amount
already paid (422 `AMOUNT_BELOW_PAID`). Unknown student numbers are created automatically
(`studentCreated: true`). Only USD is supported.

requestBody.description: Student number, term, amount and currency.

422.description: New amount is below the amount already paid.

post.summary: Adds or updates tuition for many students from a CSV file.
post.description:
Upload a CSV (field name `file`, max 1 MB, max 5,000 rows) with the header
`studentNo,term,amount,currency`. Each row is processed independently with the same rules as
Add Tuition; the response reports success/failure counts and per-line errors.

200.description: Batch processed (some rows may have failed; see `errors`).

400.description: Missing file, wrong header or no data rows (`INVALID_CSV`).

get.summary: Lists students with unpaid tuition for a term (paged).
get.description:
Returns records with a balance greater than zero, ordered by balance (highest first), then student number.
A page beyond the last page returns an empty `items` list.

400.description: Missing/invalid term or invalid paging values.

post.summary: Issues an access token (OAuth 2.0 password and client-credentials grants, JSON body).
post.description:
Students log in with their student number and password, admins with their username and password
(`grantType = "password"`). The banking app is a machine client and uses
`grantType = "client_credentials"`. The token is valid for 60 minutes.
At the gateway this endpoint is rate-limited to 10 requests per minute per IP.

400.description: Missing fields or unknown grant type (`VALIDATION_ERROR`).

post.summary: Records a partial or full tuition payment.
post.description:
Payments are simulated (no card processing) and post immediately. Rules:
duplicate `transactionId` → 409 `DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION` (with the original payment);
amount above the outstanding balance → 422 `AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE`; fully paid term → 422 `ALREADY_PAID`.
Role `bank` may pay for any student; role `student` only for itself.
The AI agent sends `X-Client-Channel: ai-agent` so the payment is recorded with channel `AI_AGENT`.

requestBody.description: Student number, term, amount and a unique transaction ID.

403.description: Role not allowed, or a student paying for another student.

404.description: No tuition record for the student and term.

409.description: Duplicate transaction ID or concurrent update.

422.description: Amount exceeds the balance, or the term is already paid.

get.summary: Returns the tuition total and balance for a student number (banking app).
get.description:
Requires a bearer token. Role `bank` may query any student; role `student` may query only
the student number in its own token (otherwise 403 `FORBIDDEN_NOT_OWNER`). The AI agent uses this
endpoint with the signed-in student's token. Omit `term` for the overall balance.

403.description: Role not allowed, or a student querying another student.

404.description: Unknown student, or no record for the term.

get.summary: Returns the tuition total and balance for a student number (mobile app).
get.description:
No authentication, as required by the specification. Limited to **3 calls per student number per UTC day**
(enforced at the gateway, keyed by the student number in the path, and again by a database counter here).
Omit `term` for the overall balance across all terms; pass `term` (e.g. `2026-FALL`) for one term.
Response headers `X-Daily-Limit` and `X-Daily-Remaining` show the backend counter.

404.description: Unknown student, or no record for the term.

amount.description: Assessed tuition total in USD (> 0, at most two decimals).

AddTuitionRequest.description: Add Tuition request (create or update the assessed tuition for a student and term).

studentCreated.description: True when the student number was unknown and a student record was created.

BatchImportResponse.description: Batch import summary. Rows are processed independently (partial success is possible).

line.description: Line number in the file (the header is line 1).

BatchRowError.description: One failed row of a batch import.

amount.description: Amount in USD; > 0, at most two decimals, not more than the outstanding balance.

transactionId.description: Caller-generated unique ID (idempotency key). Re-using it returns 409.

PayTuitionRequest.description: Pay Tuition request. Payments are simulated: no card data is accepted or stored.

totalPaid.description: Total paid for the term after this payment.

balance.description: Outstanding balance = tuition total − paid amount.

username.description: Student number (students) or admin username. Required for the password grant.

clientId.description: Banking app client id. Required for the client_credentials grant.

clientSecret.description: Banking app client secret. Required for the client_credentials grant.

accessToken.description: RS256-signed JWT. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

term.description: The requested term, or null for the overall scope.

terms.description: Per-term breakdown in chronological order (SPRING < SUMMER < FALL within a year).

TuitionQueryResponse.description:
Query Tuition result. With a `term` parameter the scope is `TERM` and the totals are for that term;
without it the scope is `OVERALL` and the totals are summed over all terms (`terms` lists each term).

UnpaidTuitionItem.description: One student with an outstanding balance.

totalOutstanding.description: Sum of all outstanding balances for the term (all pages).

UnpaidTuitionResponse.description: Paged list of students with unpaid tuition for a term, ordered by balance (highest first).

Bearer.description: RS256 JWT from POST /api/v1/auth/token (paste the token only, without 'Bearer ').
